candidate_id.description: Restrict to this candidate; omit for all candidates present in the input.

polarity_source.description: How direction is decided. `reference_match` reads ref_dosage from the reference_genome_layer row; `outgroup_vote` uses one or more outgroup samples; `majority_allele` polarizes against the cohort's modal class; `force_unchanged` is a passthrough (useful for the 1st run before a reference is registered).

outgroup_sample_ids.description: Used when polarity_source = outgroup_vote. Outgroup samples whose karyotype defines class 0 (reference-like).

unpolarized_karyotype_calls.description: Per (sample, candidate) calls on the 0/1/2 axis without polarity. Produced by karyotype_auto_caller.

reference_genome_layer.description: Per-candidate reference annotation. Required when polarity_source = reference_match. Each row: { candidate_id, ref_dosage ∈ {0,1,2}, source }.
